academicYear: GE Semester A 2026/27; Major Semester A 2027/28; normative four-year degree
note: The current official normative curriculum publishes a 121- or 128-credit graduation structure, 31 Gateway Education credits and a 72- or 79-credit Major. This supplement exposes 67 unique stable course codes from the named GE, 57-credit Core, two optional Stream and 15-credit Elective tables. Biological Sciences students must take BMS4206 or BMS4304 unless they choose the Human and Artificial Intelligence Stream; Stream and Elective courses may not be double-counted. Because the open GE distributional pool, optional Streams, mixed-credit Elective combinations and cross-group no-double-counting rules are not closed by the local rule engine, the list remains browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
